Practice 'Gutierrez Group' is the ordering physician's institution, NOT the testing vendor.
No MRN — ID # 5191 is the Accession Number, not a true MRN. Per strict MRN rule, Patient_MRN = null.
Ordering physician 'Dr. Jennifer Johnson' and signing pathologist 'Jennifer Johnson' share name — recurring mock-data quirk across the doc_* batch. Signing pathologist has no schema-v2 field.
Procedure left null: the report does not literally print a procedure name (e.g. 'Next Generation Sequencing'); xT is the product/panel, not the methodology phrase.
